Settings.Title: Token Movement FX
Settings.MenuHint: Choose which animation plays for each token movement action.
Settings.EnableHint: When disabled, no movement animations are played.
Settings.Intro: Choose the animation for each movement type. The table lists Automated Animations teleport presets (e.g. Misty Step) and On Token/AEFX entries. Presets delegate to AA for Teleport and Burrow; persistent On Token entries can follow the token and be removed when the movement ends.
Settings.PlayOnHint: When the chosen animation is an Automated Animations teleport preset, the module hands the moving token to AA. Drop the token where you want it: that point is the destination, AA's range circle is skipped, and AA handles sound, effects, fade and the move. On Token and Item animations start the departure effect as soon as the movement begins.
Settings.HideHint: Hides the token between the departure and arrival animation. Only used when the animation has a target/preset section. Delegated Teleport/Burrow presets use the preset's own Alpha/Fade instead.
Settings.RemovePersistentHint: When the animation is a persistent On Token effect, remove only the effects this movement created on the token once the movement ends. Other persistent auras on the same token are left alone.
Settings.HideNote: Hide during movement makes the token invisible while it moves and reveals it when the arrival animation starts. It needs an animation with a Target section or a preset. Teleport/Burrow presets delegated to Automated Animations ignore this box: the preset's Alpha/Delay Fade/Delay Return controls the token there.
Settings.TestHint: Play a test on the selected token. Persistent effects created by the test are removed after 1 second.
Settings.NoSequencer: Sequencer is not active. Animations cannot be played.
Settings.NoAnimations: No compatible animation found. Create or edit an On Token entry, configure an item with the A-A button, or use a teleportation preset (e.g. Misty Step).
Settings.DedicatedHint: Use this token's own animation for this movement instead of the global one.
Settings.ResetHint: Clear this token's overrides and follow the global settings again.
Settings.UnsavedMessage: You have changes that were not saved yet. Do you want to save before closing?

Notifications.NoToken: Select a token on the canvas to test the animation.
Notifications.TestFailed: The test animation could not be played. See the browser console for details.
Notifications.NoAAMenu: Could not open the Automated Animations menu.
Notifications.NoAnimationsFound: No animation found with the stored reference. Open Configure animations and pick one again.
